snippet.title: PlayStation - Spec Ops - Airborne Commando (2002)
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
The never-ending battle against the enemies of life, liberty, and justice is about to gain a new hero. Spec Ops: Airborne Commando is a 3rd-person action shooter sending YOU deep behind enemy lines to carry out top-secret covert operations. Rescue friendly forces, destroy strategic military structures, secure intelligence information, and eliminate high-profile targets. Remember your training, soldier, and you will make it out alive!

* Dive into hostile territory as an expertly trained and superbly equipped U.S. Airborne Ranger.

* Execute precise maneuvers during 16 challenging missions to rescue hostages, destroy bridges, disable radar sites, and more.

* Engage the enemy with weapons like the M4 Machine Gun, LAW Rockets, and Hand Grenades.

* Gain the tactical advantage in dense jungles, barren deserts, rugged mountains, and snow-filled forests.

* Rely upon superior equipment such as Laser Targeters, Mine Detectors, and advanced computers to accomplish mission goals!
